name: Sakura Shino
source:
Until junior high school, he was constantly in and out of the hospital due to illness. When he was young, he had a complex about being physically weak, but now he is completely clear. He went to a private high school where he got below average grades, then went to a flower design school. He curently works in "SAKURA fleur," which is run by his parents.

Having a flower shop has been his dream since he was little, so every day is fun. He often bleeds from his mouth, probably because his body is weak. He's clever and cheerful, a popular person who is kind to everyone. His motto is "Get help from people who are good at what you are not good at, and vice versa."

[Translated from [url=https://saya-sp.com/hanasaya_gp_op/layer_if/layer_ifb_character/]official website[/url]]
